title: Hold-to-delete ember burn card
blurb: Press and hold the delete button on a live HTML card to ignite a WebGL ember burn from the button's bounding box. Release early to cool back intact, or burn through to an active undo card.
question: When you press and hold a dangerous button inside a live editable HTML card, can one WebGL 2 canvas ignite an FBM ember burn from the button's bounding box, cool back intact on early release, and hand hit testing to an undo card at 100%?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas uploads both drawable cards via texElementSubImage2D(), runs an FBM and cellular ember burn from uOriginRect, quenches on early release, and swaps inert plus updateElementGeometry() at 100%.
